title: The LBO debt schedule is circular, and the answer key stores unconverged iteration values for it, so a LibreOffice recalculation of a correct output gives either Err:522 (iteration off) or converged numbers more than 1% away from the key.
evidence: 'LBO & Lenders' S50=S53-S52, S51=SUM(S49:S50), S53=S54*AVERAGE(S49,S51)*(7/12) (same pattern T:X). The golden S50 is -3.81443597 vs input -3.81443845 with identical formulas. Golden T53=118.97 and T50=-7.494, but the closed-form solution gives T53≈119.22 and T50≈-7.24 (about 3% off). Affected: rows 49-59, R47:X47, R62, R63.
confirmation: Golden 'LBO & Lenders' T53=118.97 is not converged (T54*AVERAGE(T49,T51) with its own cached T51 gives 119.2), and with iterate=true all three run outputs in <id> recalc to T50=-7.244 vs the key's -7.494 (3.3%), a modification-cell miss for any correct file.
